dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員です。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm a counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: こんにちはよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, it's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: 最初に年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 16歳　高校生　女子です
dialogue.English: I'm a 16-year-old high school girl.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。学年も教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Could you also tell me your grade?

dialogue.content: 一年生です
dialogue.English: I’m a first-year.

dialogue.content: お返事ありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing. What brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 外見の悩みです。ブスで、自分の顔が大嫌いです。
dialogue.English: It's about my appearance. I'm ugly, and I really hate my face.

dialogue.content: 何もやる気が起きません
dialogue.English: I don't feel motivated to do anything.

dialogue.content: 毎日悩んでいてら楽しくないです
dialogue.English: Worrying about it every day isn't fun at all.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 目が細くて一重だし、鼻は上向いていて、出っ歯なんです
dialogue.English: My eyes are narrow and I have monolids, my nose is upturned, and I have buck teeth.

dialogue.content: そう思っているんですね。いつごろからそういうことが気になるようになったのですか？
dialogue.English: That's how you see it. When did you start feeling concerned about these things?

dialogue.content: 小さい頃から気にしています
dialogue.English: I’ve been self-conscious about it since I was little.

dialogue.content: 気づいた時から
dialogue.English: For as long as I can remember.

dialogue.content: 可愛い服を着ても似合いません
dialogue.English: Even when I wear cute clothes, they don’t suit me.

dialogue.content: そう思ってきたんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand that's how you've been feeling.

dialogue.content: こんな顔でずっと生きていくなんて、辛すぎます
dialogue.English: Living with this face forever is just too painful.

dialogue.content: 整形したい
dialogue.English: I want to get plastic surgery.

dialogue.content: そう思うとつらいですよね。
dialogue.English: It must be painful to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 親も言います
dialogue.English: My parents say it too.

dialogue.content: 可愛くないって
dialogue.English: That I’m not cute.

dialogue.content: 顔と服が釣り合ってないって笑います
dialogue.English: They laugh and say my face doesn’t match my clothes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか。親からもそんなこと言われたら悲しすぎますよ。
dialogue.English: Is that so? It must be incredibly sad to hear that from your own parents.

dialogue.content: 親の顔は特別ひどく無いと思います
dialogue.English: I don't think my parents' faces are particularly bad.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。そんなこと言うのはお父さん？
dialogue.English: I see. Is it your father who says things like that?

dialogue.content: 2人ともかな何となくお母さんと似てるけど
dialogue.English: Both of them, I guess. I kind of resemble my mother, though.

dialogue.content: お母さんは普通の顔
dialogue.English: My mom has an average face.

dialogue.content: 悪いとこもらった感じ
dialogue.English: It feels like I inherited the bad parts.

dialogue.content: そうおもうんですね。ご自分では、でもどことなくお母さんに似ているかなという感じなんですね。
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel. But you also feel that you somewhat resemble your mother.

dialogue.content: そう親は笑うくせに、大事な身体とか、健康なら有難いとか言います
dialogue.English: Yes, even though my parents laugh at me, they also say things like my body is precious and I should be grateful for my health.

dialogue.content: だから、絶対整形はさせてもらえない
dialogue.English: That's why they'll never let me get plastic surgery.

dialogue.content: なるほど。もしかしたら健康なのは大事な事かもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: I see. Perhaps being healthy is indeed important.

dialogue.content: 確かに病気の人から見たら、贅沢な悩みかもしれないけど
dialogue.English: I guess from the perspective of someone who is sick, my worries might seem like a luxury, but...

dialogue.content: 整形の話はご両親には相談したことはあるのですか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever talked to your parents about plastic surgery?

dialogue.content: 悩んでる事が違うだけだと思う
dialogue.English: I think it's just that our worries are different.

dialogue.content: いつも言ってる
dialogue.English: I tell them all the time.

dialogue.content: でも、馬鹿な事言うなって言います
dialogue.English: But they just tell me not to say such stupid things.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ご兄弟はどんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: What about your siblings?

dialogue.content: 兄と姉がいるけど、普通だと思います。こんな顔で外を歩きたく無い
dialogue.English: I have an older brother and sister, and I think they look normal. I don’t want to walk outside with this face.

dialogue.content: そこまで思い詰めていらっしゃるんですね・・・
dialogue.English: You’re feeling that distressed about it...

dialogue.content: アイプチやっても二重にならないし
dialogue.English: Even when I use eyelid glue, I can’t get double eyelids.

dialogue.content: ご自分で試してもいるんですね。
dialogue.English: So you've been trying things on your own.

dialogue.content: 調べたら、一重の人がアイプチで二重になるのは珍しいって書いてあって
dialogue.English: I looked it up, and it said it's rare for people with monolids to get double eyelids with eyelid glue.

dialogue.content: もうダメだー！って
dialogue.English: And I just thought, "It's hopeless!"

dialogue.content: そう思ってしまったんですね。
dialogue.English: That’s how it felt to you.

dialogue.content: もう最悪
dialogue.English: It’s the worst.

dialogue.content: う～ん　辛いですね。
dialogue.English: Hmm, that must be painful.

dialogue.content: 一重でも可愛い子はいるけど、
dialogue.English: There are cute girls even with monolids, but...

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: That’s true.

dialogue.content: 他のパーツが良ければまだマシ
dialogue.English: If their other features are good, it's not as bad.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私は1ヶ所良くなっても他が悪い
dialogue.English: For me, even if one part improves, the others are bad.

dialogue.content: キリがない
dialogue.English: There’s no end to it.

dialogue.content: そう思ってしまうんですね。
dialogue.English: That's how you end up feeling.

dialogue.content: 顔ごと変えたい
dialogue.English: I want to change my whole face.

dialogue.content: 学校の友達はどんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: What are your friends at school like?

dialogue.content: 私からしたらみんな可愛い
dialogue.English: To me, they all look cute.

dialogue.content: そう見えてしまうんですね。
dialogue.English: That’s how they appear to you.

dialogue.content: どの子見てもいいなぁって思う
dialogue.English: No matter which girl I look at, I think, "She's so lucky."

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 鼻が綺麗だと美人に見えるけど
dialogue.English: If you have a nice nose, you look beautiful, but...

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 上向いてると
dialogue.English: If it’s upturned,

dialogue.content: ブサイク
dialogue.English: it’s ugly.

dialogue.content: もう最悪
dialogue.English: It’s the worst.

dialogue.content: そう思ってしまうんですね
dialogue.English: That’s how you end up feeling.

dialogue.content: 真正面から見て穴が二つ空いてる
dialogue.English: Looking straight on, you just see two holes.

dialogue.content: そう見えるんですね
dialogue.English: That’s how it looks to you.

dialogue.content: 自力で下を向かせる方法はない
dialogue.English: There’s no way to make it point downward on my own.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: もう最悪
dialogue.English: It's the absolute worst.

dialogue.content: そう思うと　やりきれないですね
dialogue.English: Thinking that way must feel unbearable.

dialogue.content: 学校でも、こんな顔の人いない
dialogue.English: Even at school, there’s no one with a face like mine.

dialogue.content: 変な顔
dialogue.English: It’s a weird face.

dialogue.content: もう嫌だ
dialogue.English: I can't stand it anymore.

dialogue.content: そんな風に思うと　やりきれないですね。
dialogue.English: It must feel unbearable to think that way.

dialogue.content: 何にもやりたくないから勉強もしたくない
dialogue.English: I don’t want to do anything, so I don’t want to study either.

dialogue.content: だから親に怒られる
dialogue.English: That's why my parents get angry at me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: せっかく入った高校なのに、やる気が起きない
dialogue.English: I worked so hard to get into this high school, but I have no motivation.

dialogue.content: 親に怒られると　楽しくないですよね
dialogue.English: It's not fun when your parents get angry at you, is it?

dialogue.content: 中学と違って、みんなお洒落だから
dialogue.English: Unlike in middle school, everyone here is so fashionable.

dialogue.content: 余計差が出る
dialogue.English: It just highlights the difference even more.

dialogue.content: 目指していた高校だったんですね。
dialogue.English: So this was the high school you were aiming for.

dialogue.content: はい、合格して嬉しかったけど、
dialogue.English: Yes, I was happy when I got in, but...

dialogue.content: クラスにいるのも辛い
dialogue.English: It's painful just being in class.

dialogue.content: この高校に入るために　頑張ったんですね。
dialogue.English: You worked hard to get into this high school.

dialogue.content: だけどみんなお洒落で可愛い
dialogue.English: But everyone is so fashionable and cute.

dialogue.content: そう見えてしまうと　引いてしまうという感じですね・・・
dialogue.English: When you see them that way, it makes you want to withdraw...

dialogue.content: もう学校も行きたくないな
dialogue.English: I don’t even want to go to school anymore.

dialogue.content: そこまで思っているんですね。
dialogue.English: You're feeling that strongly about it.

dialogue.content: 可愛いみんなを見るために行ってるようなもの
dialogue.English: It's like I'm just going there to see all the cute girls.

dialogue.content: そう思うとやりきれないですね
dialogue.English: That must feel unbearable.

dialogue.content: なんでこんな顔に生まれたんだろう
dialogue.English: Why was I born with a face like this?

dialogue.content: そんな思いにもなりますよね
dialogue.English: It’s understandable to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 小学校の時のあだ名は豚ゴリラだった
dialogue.English: My nickname in elementary school was "pig-gorilla."

dialogue.content: 嫌なこと思い出した
dialogue.English: I just remembered something awful.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それは辛かったですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been very painful.

dialogue.content: どうしたら可愛くなれますか？
dialogue.English: How can I become cute?

dialogue.content: 思い出すと悲しくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: Remembering that must make you feel sad.

dialogue.content: そこをご一緒に考えさせていただく前に、ここまでのお話しを少し整理させていただいてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: Before we think about that together, may I take a moment to summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: 顔のことが気になっている。自分は顔の形が美人系ではないと思っている。両親にも言われる。
dialogue.English: You're concerned about your face. You feel that your features are not beautiful. Your parents also say things about it.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: 兄弟もいるが、普通の顔に見える。
dialogue.English: You have siblings, and you see them as having normal faces.

dialogue.content: かわいい服を着ても似合わないのが辛い。
dialogue.English: It's painful because you feel that even cute clothes don't suit you.

dialogue.content: 学校に行くとみんなかわいい子に見える。
dialogue.English: At school, everyone looks cute to you.

dialogue.content: 整形をしたいと親に行ったがダメと言われた。
dialogue.English: You told your parents you want plastic surgery, but they said no.

dialogue.content: 頑張って入学した高校だけれど、学校に行く気がしなくなっている。
dialogue.English: Even though you worked hard to get into this high school, you're losing the motivation to go.

dialogue.content: 気持が載らないので勉強も手につかない。すると親に怒られる。
dialogue.English: You don't feel motivated, so you can't focus on your studies, and then your parents get angry at you.

dialogue.content: なんとかかわいくなる方法はないものかと考えてしまう。
dialogue.English: You find yourself wondering if there's any way to become cute.

dialogue.content: こんな理解でよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that an accurate understanding?

dialogue.content: だいたいそんな感じです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's more or less it.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいか分かりますか
dialogue.English: Do you have any idea what I should do?

dialogue.content: そこでひとつ、気が付いたことがあるのですが、TVに出ている女優さんたちの中には必ずしも美人系でない人もいるようなのですが？
dialogue.English: On that note, I've noticed something: among actresses on TV, there seem to be some who aren't what you'd call conventionally beautiful.

dialogue.content: ブスの女優？
dialogue.English: Ugly actresses?

dialogue.content: いわゆる美人ではないけれど、面白いとか、魅力的という人がいるみたいですけど、何がその人たちを魅力的にしているのかなと考えているのですが・・・
dialogue.English: They may not be what you'd call beautiful, but they seem to be funny or charming. I was wondering what it is that makes them so attractive...

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: よくわからないです
dialogue.English: I'm not really sure.

dialogue.content: 女優なら演技が上手いとか？
dialogue.English: If they're actresses, maybe it's because they're good at acting?

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それから　タレントさんでもいるみたいですけど・・・
dialogue.English: And it seems there are TV personalities like that as well...

dialogue.content: 女優は美人とか可愛くなくても、ブスでは無いと思う
dialogue.English: Even if an actress isn’t beautiful or cute, I don’t think she’s ugly.

dialogue.content: そう思われるんですね。
dialogue.English: That’s how you see it.

dialogue.content: 女芸人でも、そこまでブスはいない
dialogue.English: Even among female comedians, there aren’t any who are that ugly.

dialogue.content: やっぱり普通の顔
dialogue.English: They still have average faces.

dialogue.content: 私とはレベルが違う
dialogue.English: They’re on a different level from me.

dialogue.content: 私はスーパーMAXブスだから
dialogue.English: Because I'm ugly to the max.

dialogue.content: そこまで思っているんですね。ところで　先ほど　あなたが言ってたこと　女優なら演技がうまいと　光って見える　というのはきっとそうだとおもいました。
dialogue.English: You feel that strongly about it. By the way, regarding what you said earlier, that an actress can shine if she's a good actor—I think that's certainly true.

dialogue.content: 特別な能力があればいいけど、
dialogue.English: It would be nice if I had a special talent, but...

dialogue.content: 私には何もないです
dialogue.English: I don't have anything.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうかもしれませんね、タレントさんでも　いわゆる美人じゃなくて　個性的な顔の人でも　一生懸命な人は　応援したくなるんですけど・・・
dialogue.English: I see, that might be true. But even with TV personalities who aren't conventionally beautiful and have unique faces, if they're trying their best, you want to cheer for them...

dialogue.content: あなたに　本当に何もないか　決してそんなことはないと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: I truly don't believe that you have nothing to offer.

dialogue.content: 勉強も出来ないし、運動も苦手だし
dialogue.English: I'm not good at studying, and I'm not good at sports either.

dialogue.content: そう思っているんですね。部活は何をやっているの？
dialogue.English: That’s how you feel. What club are you in?

dialogue.content: 文芸部です
dialogue.English: I'm in the literary club.

dialogue.content: 編み物したり、ハーバリウム作ったり、
dialogue.English: We do things like knitting and making herbariums,

dialogue.content: 好きで入ったというより
dialogue.English: It's less that I joined because I liked it,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 入る部活がなかったから
dialogue.English: and more that there were no other clubs for me to join.

dialogue.content: なるほど　それも一つの選択ですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That is one way to choose, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 特に好きなこととか、趣味とかもないです
dialogue.English: I don't have any particular likes or hobbies either.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: あなたが今までに面白いと思ったことって何でしたか？
dialogue.English: What are some things you've found interesting in your life so far?

dialogue.content: うーん、思いつかないけど
dialogue.English: Hmm, I can't think of anything, but...

dialogue.content: 文章書くのは好きかも
dialogue.English: I might like writing.

dialogue.content: 自分がこうなったらいいなぁって
dialogue.English: I write about things like, "I wish I could be like this."

dialogue.content: ことを文章に書いてたり
dialogue.English: I write those things down.

dialogue.content: いいですね。
dialogue.English: That's wonderful.

dialogue.content: 日記とか？
dialogue.English: Like a diary?

dialogue.content: 日記というより理想を書いてる
dialogue.English: It's more like writing about my ideals than a diary.

dialogue.content: そんな文章を書いている時はどんな気分ですか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel when you're writing those things?

dialogue.content: 少しスッキリします
dialogue.English: I feel a little relieved.

dialogue.content: でも、絶対そうはなれないから
dialogue.English: But I know I can never be that way,

dialogue.content: 理想と現実
dialogue.English: Ideals versus reality...

dialogue.content: 現実を考えるとさらに落ち込む
dialogue.English: when I think about reality, I get even more depressed.

dialogue.content: 確かにそういう見方もあるかもしれませんが、もしかしたら、文章を書くことにあなたの道があるのかもしれませんね・・・
dialogue.English: That's certainly one way to look at it, but perhaps your path lies in writing...

dialogue.content: 勉強してるフリで書いてるだけだけど
dialogue.English: I only write while pretending to study, though.

dialogue.content: すっきりするなら　きっと　文章を書くことが　あなたに向いているみたいですね。
dialogue.English: If it makes you feel better, then writing must be a good fit for you.

dialogue.content: そんなのかなぁ
dialogue.English: I wonder if that's true.

dialogue.content: でも文章書いてどうしたら良いですか？
dialogue.English: But what should I do with my writing?

dialogue.content: 理想を書くと言っていましたけど、その他に、辛い思い、みつけたちいさなたのしみ・・・などなどいろいろ　書いてみてはいかがでしょうか・・・
dialogue.English: You said you write about your ideals, but how about trying to write about other things, like your painful feelings, the small joys you find, and so on?

dialogue.content: 何がある？
dialogue.English: Like what?

dialogue.content: ストレス解消で？
dialogue.English: As a way to relieve stress?

dialogue.content: それもあるかもしれません。続けていると　文章を書くことが次第に磨かれていくかもしれませんよ・・・
dialogue.English: That could be part of it. If you keep at it, your writing skills might gradually improve...

dialogue.content: あーそうか
dialogue.English: Oh, I see.

dialogue.content: 将来的に良いと？
dialogue.English: So it could be good for my future?

dialogue.content: はい将来にとっても役に立つと思います。続けていると　次第に文章を書くことが更に上手になっていくと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think it could be very helpful for your future. If you continue, you’ll likely get better and better at writing.

dialogue.content: 更に文章を書いていると、考える力も磨かれて行きますよ。
dialogue.English: Moreover, as you continue to write, it will sharpen your thinking skills as well.

dialogue.content: きっと　あなたにとってプラスになっていくと思います。
dialogue.English: I'm sure it will be a positive thing for you.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。少しでも楽しいことを考えてたら、顔のことをわすれてますから
dialogue.English: I see. When I'm thinking about something even a little bit fun, I forget about my face.

dialogue.content: それももしかしたら大事な事かもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: That may be an important thing as well.

dialogue.content: あなたを応援しています。
dialogue.English: I’m rooting for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。そうですね、ひたすら書いてみます
dialogue.English: Thank you. You're right, I’ll just keep writing.

dialogue.content: あなたが楽しく時を過ごせるように、これからもご一緒に考えさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: I’d like to continue thinking together with you so that you can spend your time more enjoyably.

dialogue.content: よければまた来てください。
dialogue.English: Please feel free to come again.

dialogue.content: もしまた悩んだら相談しますね
dialogue.English: If I'm struggling again, I’ll reach out.

dialogue.content: お待ちしていますね。
dialogue.English: I’ll be here for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 今日の所はこの辺でよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Shall we wrap up for today?

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 今日はいらしてくださりありがとうございます。では失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today. Goodbye.

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.
